title: Base change of finite split étale hypercovers
statement: For qcqs schemes X,Y, a finite split étale hypercover U of Y and a morphism f:X→Y, construct a finite split étale hypercover of X by applying étale base change in every simplicial degree. Its nondegenerate terms and splitting inclusions are the pullbacks of those of U. Matching objects and their projections are pulled back as well.

proof.text: Finite étale coproduct cofans remain colimiting under base change. Each finite-presentation qcqs constituent stays finite-presentation and qcqs over the qcqs new base. The map-pullback adjunction transfers the universal property of each matching object; naturality transfers its projection equations. Matching covers remain covers under base change. Apply the inverse-image unit to obtain the cosimplicial section map, alternating cochain map, and homology map. Unit naturality proves refinement compatibility.
